aspect: EXAMPLE - what it costs a business
description: ANPEC's president says the fee usually runs 500 to 1,000 pesos per week. ANPEC estimated in 2024 that cobro de piso takes between 10% and 20% of income for affected small businesses. Official figures quantifying it as a share of business income are otherwise lacking.
energy_note: A fifth of the takings, weekly, in cash.

description: Coparmex, the employers' association, put the cost to businesses at some $1.3 billion in 2023, and indicated losses of more than one billion dollars again in 2025.
energy_note: Over a billion dollars a year, in protection money.

aspect: EXAMPLE - and almost none of it is reported
description: INEGI estimates 97% of extortion goes unreported. ENVIPE 2024 found extortion was the crime most reported by economic units of every size, with one in four victimised firms affected by it. Firm-level figures come from ENVE rather than ENVIPE.
energy_note: One business in four, and almost no complaints.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the trend and the new law
description: Extortion rose 10% nationally in Q1 2025; Mexico City cases nearly doubled in five months to 498 from 249. SESNSP recorded a record 5,887 extortion victims in H1 2025. A national strategy launched July 2025 and a federal law effective 29 November 2025 created a unified offence prosecutable without a complaint, with 15-25 year base sentences. SESNSP then reported a 38% decline; independent analysts question the methodology.
energy_note: A record, a new law, and a disputed improvement.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the polite young man on Friday
description: He is perhaps nineteen and he is not threatening. He says he knows the shop has been busy, asks after the daughter by name, and mentions that the price has gone up to 900 from next week. Then he buys a Coke and pays for it.
energy_note: He pays for the Coke. That is the part that frightens him.

aspect: The payment is what keeps him from reporting the payment
description: Once he has paid, he has participated, which he believes exposes him - so the first payment purchases the silence that protects all the subsequent ones.
energy_note: The first payment buys the silence for the rest.
